calibration.prompt_text: Explain in two sentences why water boils at a lower temperature at high altitude.

policy_notes: Thresholds are frozen from three calibration prompts, 39 captured tensors from layers 0/15/29, full and sharded logits, teacher-forcing logits and one incremental decode sequence.
Per-lm_head-shard rank is diagnostic; each shard is still gated numerically and by exact vocabulary position through the declared-reference slice.
Official free-generation divergence is reported, not used as the backend numeric gate.
Complete acceptance requires numeric and quality evidence plus sealed calibration and acceptance observation bundles.

quality.policy: limits are derived only from calibration data with a fixed margin; the acceptance text windows are disjoint
